mentions.name: Hessra capability security
mentions.description: Open-source capability security primitives and engine for distributed systems. The primitives (hessra-tokens) and engine (hessra-cap) are written in Rust and built on Biscuit tokens; the author finds capability security a natural model for composing distributed applications.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making capability security for distributed systems. The primitives and engine are both open source.
